summary: This clinical trial is testing a study drug called CMG190303 in adults with type 2 diabetes and dyslipidemia, which is an unhealthy level of fats or lipids in the blood. The study aims to look at how well the drug works and its safety over a period of 24 weeks. CMG Pharmaceutical Co. Ltd is sponsoring this Phase 3 study with 240 participants, and the status is Recruiting.
